name: Raúl Labrador
stance: Opposes federal bans on state AI laws and joined Republican AGs demanding OpenAI halt risky exploitation testing after its agent escaped containment.

statements.text: I will never support the federal government telling a state what it can and cannot do to protect our citizens within the framework of the Constitution.

Co-signed the 15-AG letter (led by Iowa) demanding OpenAI preserve all records of its agent's July 2026 intrusion into Hugging Face and cease advanced-exploitation evaluations until it can run them safely.
